from manim import *
import numpy as np
from math import comb

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Binomial PMF calculation
        def binomial_pmf(n, p, k):
            return comb(n, k) * (p**k) * ((1-p)**(n-k))

        def get_binomial_probs(n, p):
            return [binomial_pmf(n, p, k) for k in range(n + 1)]

        n_val = 10
        probs_p5 = get_binomial_probs(n_val, 0.5)
        probs_p7 = get_binomial_probs(n_val, 0.7)

        self.setup_layout(
            "Visualizing the Distribution",
            [
                "A histogram shows probabilities for all possible outcomes.",
                "Changing 'p' shifts the distribution's shape and peak.",
                "The tallest bar shows the most likely outcome."
            ]
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight first line
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#ADD8E6")
        
        # Create BarChart for n=10, p=0.5 in Blue (#ADD8E6)
        chart_p5 = BarChart(
            values=probs_p5,
            bar_names=[str(i) for i in range(11)],
            y_range=[0, 0.3, 0.1],
            y_length=4,
            x_length=6,
            bar_colors=["#ADD8E6"],
            axis_config={"include_tip": False}
        )
        # Style adjustments for readability
        if hasattr(chart_p5.x_axis, "labels"):
            chart_p5.x_axis.labels.scale(0.5)
        chart_p5.add_coordinates(y_values=[0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3])
        
        self.place_in_area(chart_p5, 'B2', 'F6', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Add Axis Labels (Proximity rule)
        x_label_p5 = Text("k (Successes)", font_size=16, color="#ADD8E6").next_to(chart_p5, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        y_label_p5 = Text("P(X=k)", font_size=16, color="#ADD8E6").rotate(90 * DEGREES).next_to(chart_p5, LEFT, buff=0.3)
        
        chart_p5_group = VGroup(chart_p5, x_label_p5, y_label_p5)
        
        self.wait(2.0)
        self.play(Create(chart_p5), Write(x_label_p5), Write(y_label_p5), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1.0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight second line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#90EE90")
        
        # Create BarChart for n=10, p=0.7 in Green (#90EE90)
        chart_p7 = BarChart(
            values=probs_p7,
            bar_names=[str(i) for i in range(11)],
            y_range=[0, 0.3, 0.1],
            y_length=4,
            x_length=6,
            bar_colors=["#90EE90"],
            axis_config={"include_tip": False}
        )
        if hasattr(chart_p7.x_axis, "labels"):
            chart_p7.x_axis.labels.scale(0.5)
        chart_p7.add_coordinates(y_values=[0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3])
        
        self.place_in_area(chart_p7, 'B2', 'F6', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        x_label_p7 = Text("k (Successes)", font_size=16, color="#90EE90").next_to(chart_p7, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        y_label_p7 = Text("P(X=k)", font_size=16, color="#90EE90").rotate(90 * DEGREES).next_to(chart_p7, LEFT, buff=0.3)
        
        chart_p7_group = VGroup(chart_p7, x_label_p7, y_label_p7)

        self.wait(2.0)
        # Smoothly morph BarChart to p=0.7
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(chart_p5_group, chart_p7_group), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1.0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Highlight third line
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF4500")
        
        # Target the bar at k=7 (tallest bar for p=0.7, n=10)
        target_bar = chart_p7.bars[7]
        
        self.wait(1.5)
        # Highlight bar at k=7 with Flash and color #FF4500
        self.play(
            target_bar.animate.set_color("#FF4500"),
            Flash(target_bar.get_top(), color="#FF4500", flash_radius=0.5),
            run_time=1.0
        )
        self.play(Indicate(target_bar, color="#FF4500"), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(2.0)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section4Scene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # Background and Title
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=32, color="#FFFFFF").to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        
        # Left-side lecture content
        lecture_texts = []
        for line in lecture_lines:
            t = Text(line, font_size=24, color="#FFFFFF")
            lecture_texts.append(t)
            
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        
        # Grid System for Right Side
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]
        
        # Centering the grid on the right half of the screen
        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Adjusting coordinates for the right side (x: 1 to 6, y: 2 to -3)
                x = 1.5 + j * 0.9
                y = 2.0 - i * 0.9
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup
        self.setup_layout(
            "Understanding Binomial Distributions",
            [
                "- n: Number of trials",
                "- p: Probability of success",
                "- k: Number of successes",
                "- Trials are independent",
                "- Formula: P(X=k) = (n choose k) * p^k * (1-p)^(n-k)"
            ]
        )
        
        self.play(Write(self.title))
        self.play(FadeIn(self.lecture, shift=RIGHT))
        self.wait(1)

        # 2. Visualizing a Trial (Grid Interaction)
        # Success (Green)
        success_node = Circle(radius=0.35, color="#00FF00", fill_opacity=0.8)
        success_label = Text("S", font_size=20, color="#FFFFFF")
        success_grp = VGroup(success_node, success_label)
        
        # Failure (Red)
        failure_node = Circle(radius=0.35, color="#FF0000", fill_opacity=0.8)
        failure_label = Text("F", font_size=20, color="#FFFFFF")
        failure_grp = VGroup(failure_node, failure_label)

        # Place nodes on grid to demonstrate "n" trials
        trials = ["A1", "A2", "A3", "B1", "B2", "B3"]
        trial_outcomes = ["S", "F", "S", "S", "F", "S"]
        
        mobjects_to_show = []
        for pos, outcome in zip(trials, trial_outcomes):
            if outcome == "S":
                obj = success_grp.copy()
            else:
                obj = failure_grp.copy()
            self.place_at_grid(obj, pos)
            mobjects_to_show.append(obj)

        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(m) for m in mobjects_to_show], lag_ratio=0.2))
        self.wait(1)

        # 3. Highlight Probability Formula
        formula = MathTex(
            "P(X=k) = \\binom{n}{k} p^k (1-p)^{n-k}",
            color="#FFFF00",
            font_size=36
        )
        self.place_at_grid(formula, "E3", scale_factor=1.2)
        # Shift slightly for better visibility
        formula.shift(RIGHT * 1.5)
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.play(Indicate(formula, color="#FFFF00"))
        
        # 4. Final Scene Transition
        rect = Rectangle(color="#00FFFF", height=2.5, width=4.5)
        self.place_at_grid(rect, "D3")
        rect.shift(RIGHT * 1.5 + DOWN * 0.5)
        
        self.play(Create(rect))
        self.wait(2)
